full_judgment: Abu Sayeed Ahammed J: - This petition for leave to appeal is at the instance of the defendant, government of Bangladesh, represented by the Deputy Commissioner, Bogra, against the judgment and order dated 30.01.2000 passed by a Single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Order No. 3439 of 2000, summarily rejecting the application under Section 115(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure upon finding inter alia that it was barred by limitation.
